_about: Recorded values and gates of benchmarks/1.3.0/regressions (see README.md). One entry per metric, keyed suite/config/metric. Written by lib/compare.py --record; gates may be tuned by hand and survive a re-record.

pins._comment: SHA-256 of the binaries the recorded values were measured with. compare.py marks a run INVALID when v1.2.2's differs (it never should: it is the release tarball's binary), or when redis-server's differs and REGRESS_REDIS_SHA256 does not name the new one (a deliberate Redis bump, after which --record stores it).
